title: Protein Expression Protocol
author: Rengin Yamur Akbiyik
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.sj2ecqe

steps.title: Transform and Plate Cells
steps.instruction: Transform BL21 cells and plate them on Ampicillin (Kan) agar.

steps.title: Prepare Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Inoculate colonies into 6 ml LB broth containing 6 µl Ampicillin and grow for 3-5 hours after overnight incubation of the plates.

steps.title: Scale Up Culture
steps.instruction: Transfer the starter culture into 1 L ZYM-5052 Medium containing 1 µl Ampicillin.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare the Binding Buffer by mixing 5 ml Imidazole and 20 ml TBS, then adding ddw up to a final volume of 200 ml.

steps.title: Resuspend Pellet
steps.instruction: Transfer the sample to a 50 ml falcon tube to obtain 35 µl of total sample, then resuspend the pellet using the Binding Buffer in a shaker.

steps.title: Sonicate Sample
steps.instruction: Perform sonication using plastic test tubes for 3 cycles, with each cycle lasting 7 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Repeat this process for a total of 3 times.
